    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = Path(path)
    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
        self.path.with_suffix('.collection.json').write_text(json.dumps([item.nodeid for item in session.items], indent=2) + '\n')
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        with self.path.open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps({'nodeid': report.nodeid, 'when': report.when, 'outcome': report.outcome, 'duration': report.duration}) + '\n')
            stream.flush()

def main():
    expected = int(sys.argv[1])
    assert jax.device_count() == expected
    assert all(device.platform == 'cpu' for device in jax.devices())
    assert resolve() is None
    root = str(Path.cwd())
    modules = {module.__name__: module.__file__ for module in (levanter, haliax, marin, iris, fray, zephyr)}

    before = hashes()
    assert before == freeze['files']
    result = pytest.main(sys.argv[4:], plugins=[Journal(sys.argv[2])])

    assert before == after
    return result

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
